page.layout: One printed page of text, set in a single block. Heading "PRÆFATIO." at the top, centred. Running text below in full lines. Ornamental asterisks centred below the text. Catchword at the lower right. No margin notes. No page number.

main_text.l: Sed quid ago? Valde metuo, ne hoc
les matronę cum maiore plausu au-
in lectione Pauli: illud Damaso pon-

page.notes: The top line "PRÆFATIO." is a title, so it is a level 1 heading. The asterisks are ornaments; I kept them as a paragraph. The "ff" in "Maffilienfis" is printed as a double long s; I read it as "Massiliensis" under the long-s rule. The faint letters at the lower left and the mirrored text across the page are show-through or the other side of the leaf, so I left them out. Some words in the line "legedis" and "mœdijs" are slightly unclear in the scan, and I copied them as they appear.
